patch.summary: Closely migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to Closely by inventorying legacy sales-intelligence fields, mapping them to Closely objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Not a CRM deal-pipeline system of record.
Success signal: prospecting works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: Closely migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power prospecting, data enrichment, email sequences and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into Closely; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate Salesforce; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when B2B outbound teams automating LinkedIn + email outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Not a CRM deal-pipeline system of record.
If Closely mapping is poor, compare destination fit with Amplemarket before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire Salesforce in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: Not a CRM deal-pipeline system of record.

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: Plans are gated by LinkedIn sender seats and enrichment/AI credit bundles.

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: Bonus enrichment/AI credits emphasized on Growth/Essential versus Starter.

checklist.label: Mitigate: Not a CRM deal-pipeline system of record.

notes: Migration: cutover risks, data mapping, checklist.
